title: basalt plugin add and enable --json, approval opened
description: What basalt plugin add --json and basalt plugin enable --json print on stdout when the command opened plugin approvals: the entry is written with "approval": "REQUIRED" and is not served until a person signs. Exit 0 when every database's approval opened, 1 when one could not be opened after the entry was written (that database's item carries refused). The agent shows personMessage to the person verbatim and follows nextSteps. See CONTRACT.md, Plugins, Plugin approval.

approvals.description: One item per database among the entry's agents, in the order of the first agent of each database in --agents.

personMessage.description: What the person reads: which agent asks, the plugin's name and version, the page's level sentence (CONTRACT.md, The plugin approval page), each link on a line of its own, and the expiry. A courtesy copy of the page's warning; the page is the protection.

links.description: The URLs of personMessage with labels, in order; present exactly when personMessage holds a URL.

database.description: The database the agents' credentials connect to, as basalt status names it: never a user, port, password or connection string.

agents.description: The entry's agents in this database, by their names in engine.json.

url.description: The link to the plugin approval page: the short link when the engine serves the local pages, else the long link, or the hash link when the long link is over linkBudget.

requestFile.description: Present exactly when url is a hash link.

refused.description: This database's approval could not be opened after the entry was written. The entry stays written and is withheld from these agents. Any guard refusal other than TOO_MANY_PENDING, UNKNOWN_AGENT and an older guard is DATABASE_UNREACHABLE, its message carrying the detail.
